verdict.rationale: Wise documents a broad public API reference covering business payments, multi-currency accounts, statements, batch transfers, cards, disputes, cases and webhooks. A dedicated sandbox, a CalVer versioning and deprecation policy, yearly changelogs and an llms.txt index round it out, so a user can drive the product programmatically. The main Platform API has no downloadable OpenAPI spec (only the legacy webhook API has one, and the probes returned 404), which weakens machine-readability for AI agents. missing for 10: public OpenAPI spec for the main API, independent hands-on corroboration of API use.
